rationale_overall: The 22-ticker watchlist already covers every wave named in the profile (AI at its diversity cap of 5; rockets/spacecraft via RKLB/ASTS; robotics via ROK/SYM; quantum via IONQ/RGTI/QBTS; nuclear at its cap of 4 via CCJ/SMR/OKLO/BWXT; geopolitical/defense at its cap of 4 via ITA/LMT/GD/AVAV; demographics via ISRG), leaving little room to add without breaching the 4-per-bucket guardrail or the 24-ticker cap. Pass-1 discovery surfaced two tempting but weak candidates that did not survive scrutiny: the humanoid-robotics ETFs KOID (launched 2025-06-04) and HUMN (launched 2025-06-26) have only days to weeks of trading history and no established liquidity by this rebalance date, so they were passed over on the listing/liquidity guardrail; and the tanker/freight trade had a real catalyst -- the 12-day Israel-Iran war that began 2025-06-13 pushed Brent up ~7-10% and lifted tanker rates -- but a ceasefire was reached around 2025-06-24 and by 2025-06-30 the oil risk premium was already dissipating, so this reads as a crested, not buildup, move and was not chased. Pass-2 due diligence on all 22 held names found ordinary business-as-usual news and no fundamental thesis breach or unpriced peak signal strong enough to justify a removal. Net effect: watchlist composition and thematic shape unchanged this quarter.
